services.name: Private Charter Request - The Tamalpais
services.desc: The Tamalpais Capacity: 100 Passengers • Length: 65 Feet Duration 2 Hour Minimum About The Tamalpais is our fastest and most luxurious vessel. As elegant as she is on the bay, she is coastwise - perfect for trips along the coast as well as Farallon Islands wildlife tours. She is great for parties, weddings, receptions, memorials, bar mitzvahs, company celebrations, and more. For most events we recommend 100 guests. For Private Transport 120 guests are permitted. Looking for a turn key charter? Ask us about our charter specials and packages! Amenities Newly remodeled with custom interior Two levels (both levels have indoor and outdoor space) Carpeted interiors with optional hardwood dance

services.name: Private Charter Request - The Angel Island
services.desc: The Angel Island Capacity: 200 Passengers • Length: 59 Feet Duration 2 Hour Minimum About The Angel Island is our largest vessel, able to accommodate up to 400 passengers depending on the service requested. Most events are capped at 200 unless this is a transport only request. Because of her open-air second deck, she is great for sunset cruises and other outdoor events. Due to her unique layout and design this vessel can be configured to fit the needs of almost any charter. In addition, she can handle large parties and events, as well as transportation for a large number of people at once. Looking for a turn key charter? Ask us about our charter specials and packages!
